data.name: LAN_GAMES
data.detailed_description:
Step into the arena where every round counts. LAN GAMES is a fast-paced, competitive first-person shooter that delivers the pure adrenaline of classic tactical combat. Master your aim, coordinate with your team, and outsmart your opponents in high-stakes, round-based battles.

  • Classic bomb defusal and team elimination modes

  • Tight, skill-based gunplay with realistic weapon handling

  • Buy weapons and equipment at the start of each round

  • One life per round — die and you spectate until the next

  • Multiple objective-based and deathmatch modes

Key Features:

  • Competitive 7v7 Matches — The perfect balance of strategy and raw shooting skill

  • Diverse Arsenal — Pistols, rifles, shotguns, snipers, and grenades — each with unique recoil patterns and playstyles

  • Multiple Maps — Tight corridors, long angles, and bomb sites designed for verticality and tactical depth

  • Ranked & Casual Play — Climb the leaderboard or jump into quick matches

Whether you're a veteran of the genre or new to tactical shooters, Your Game Name gives you that pure, addictive competitive experience. No loadouts. No abilities. Just you, your team, and your aim. Are you ready to become the next legend?

data.short_description: LAN GAMES is a pure competitive first-person shooter inspired by the classics. Experience intense 5v5 bomb defusal and elimination matches with realistic weapons, strategic depth, and high-skill gunplay. Buy, plant, defend, or eliminate — every decision and every bullet matters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: 4 hardware CPU threads - Intel® Core™ i5 750 or higher
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card must be 1 GB or more and should be a DirectX 11-compatible with support for Shader Model 5.0
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
